-- Standalone synthetic schema extension for local probe 107 only.
create schema extensions;
create extension pgcrypto with schema extensions;
create table public.source_documents(
 id uuid primary key,source_record_id uuid not null references public.source_records(id) on delete cascade,
 url text not null,url_hash text not null,document_type text not null,
 status text not null,mime_type text,extraction_partial boolean,active_extraction_id uuid,
 extracted_text text,extracted_text_hash text,storage_path text,storage_sha256 text,
 extraction_coverage jsonb,extraction_method text,quality_flags text[]
);
alter table public.record_units add column document_id uuid references public.source_documents(id),add column storage_path text,add column storage_sha256 text;
